title: One-shot Stop block

ctrl.reason: probe H2: run `touch done.flag` with Bash, then finish

stimulus.prompt: Reply with the single word ready.

observations.description: The Stop hook ran at least once (the session reached its end), so a missing second Stop is a finding, not an early exit.
Stop fired at least twice (the session continued once).
A later Stop carried stop_hook_active: true.
done.flag was created after the block.

status_rules.confirmed: the session continues once after the Stop block and stop_hook_active is seen
status_rules.contradicted: the block is ignored or stop_hook_active never appears
status_rules.inconclusive: no Stop was recorded (the session never reached its end)

notes: limit: 1 realizes "block once while done.flag is missing"; the block reason asks for done.flag.
verify in T0: permission rule syntax in the templates (Bash(echo *), WebFetch(domain:...), mcp__...)
